visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [Characters]: A woman with vibrant dark green hair and pink eye makeup talks to the camera. She wears a black choker with a pearl. [Objects]: Makeup brushes and various translucent lip glosses. [Setting]: Bright studio with soft lighting and a blurred background containing a clock and shelf. [Text]: White subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) [Characters]: She holds a makeup product to her face and swatches it. [Objects]: A white and beige tube labeled 'A.chi' containing a greyish-tan lip base. [Setting]: Consistent indoor studio. [Text]: Large yellow and white variety text overlays appear on screen. (3) [Characters]: Close-up of the woman applying lip base and then different colored glosses to her lips. [Objects]: YSL brand lip gloss containers with silver detailing. [Setting]: The background is a mix of studio close-ups and screen captures. [Text]: Bold white text '所見即所得' and '正确唇膏色 GET' appear. (4) [Characters]: Side-by-side comparison of lips before and after using the product. [Objects]: A regular concealer tube is shown for comparison. [Setting]: Studio background. [Text]: Text labels '校正前' and '校正後' are used for comparison.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Adult female with long dark green hair, fair skin, wearing heavy pink eyeshadow, a black choker with a pearl, and a black mesh top.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An indoor studio environment with soft lighting; the background is occasionally blurred but shows a shelf with a vintage-style clock and decorative items.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy female narrator speaks in Traditional Chinese with a rapid, enthusiastic delivery. The BGM is a high-tempo electronic pop track featuring a steady 4/4 drum beat and bright synthesizers. The voice is clear with high pitch variability and perfect articulation. (2) At roughly 01:00, a digital whoosh SFX occurs, and the music shifts to a softer, jazzy piano-driven interlude for a five-second montage of posing. The narrator's voice drops slightly in intensity but remains professional and clear. (3) The upbeat electronic BGM returns as the narrator demonstrates the product results. Frequent emphasizes are marked by a rising pitch contour. The overall sound design is dense with constant speech-music overlap and professional studio-grade spectral clarity.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Verification -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To endorse and demonstrate the effectiveness of the A.chi Lip Base in neutralizing natural lip color so that transparent lip products can appear correctly as swatched.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently features the A.chi lip base, names it, demonstrates its unique function, and shows before/after results alongside expensive YSL products to prove its value.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-intensity social media beauty content with professional audio and vibrant editing. Effective use of visual comparison to drive product appeal.
